messages:
mia: Quick idea for dark-mode tweaks: introduce a "moonlit grid" to improve chart separators without washing out syntax. Keeping base bg/panels same, just add mid-tone grid + tweak heatmap. Thoughts?
dan: Drop hexes so I can run diffs.
mia: Pasted CSS vars: 
--moonlit-bg: #0b0f12; --moonlit-surface: #0f1417; --grid-accent: #3f5b73; --accent-strong: #69b6ff; --heat-low: #2b3034; --heat-mid: #3f6a55; --heat-high: #ffcc6a; --syntax-keyword: #95c9ff; --syntax-string: #cfe89b; --axis-label: #9fb0b6

ashley: Grid looks ok. But accent-strong (#69b6ff) on bg (#0b0f12) is ~3.9:1; risky for normal text. Axis-label is ~4.3:1, borderline.

kevin: Also watch colorblindness: green mid + warm high may be ambiguous (deuteranopia). Prefer single-hue luminance ramp or accessible diverging map.

mia: Agree. Proposal: darken accent to #5ea7e8, swap heatmap to OrRd single-hue ramp, bump axis label to #b7c6cb.
dan: I pushed a branch with CSS vars and screenshots: https://git.company/repo/branches/moonlit-grid. Ran quick a11y script.
design-bot: Contrast checks (branch): accent #5ea7e8 on bg #0b0f12 -> 4.5:1 PASS. axis-label #b7c6cb on surface #0f1417 -> 5.0:1 PASS. OrRd ramp simulated for deuteranopia -> preserves luminance ordering PASS.

mia: Great. Action items: dan finalize screenshots, ashley do formal a11y pass + update PR checklist, kevin run colorblind sims + icon distinctions, mia update legend copy to "Token heat (rps)". Planning to ship in next minor release. :thumbsup:
